text: Implemented neutral Timeline with deterministic stable ordering of simultaneous marks, distinct PlannedTimeline and ObservedTimeline types with compile-time rejection, smart-constructed NonNegativeSpan/PositiveSpan/NonNegativeLong with checked overflow, and the fromCommonEvents/observations SyncEvidence surface. Full kernel baseline: JVM 164/164 and Scala.js 164/164; focused restored baseline 17/17 on each platform; scalafmt, git diff, and kernel-purity checks green. Compiler warnings exposed and prevented a recursive opaque-extension defect before closure. Mutation proof: reversing equal-time tie order failed the named simultaneous-input-order assertion on JVM and Scala.js; mutant restored.
